scope.description: No-crash synchronous Node histories with default validation, sequential simple voter removals, ordered finite deferred application and partitioned actual network traffic; compared nodes remain members of final membership.
assumptions: MemoryStorage models successful persistence without crash recovery.
All delivered network messages are produced by actual Nodes; no Byzantine state or identity reuse.
Removed peers continue processing actual messages without rejoining.
Application follows Ready order and calls ApplyConfChange for all committed configuration entries; synchronous early Advance is used.

parameters.application: early Advance with finite FIFO delay versus prompt activation

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target modifications or private critical-state assignments.
Normal-entry application is a no-op; configuration entries call the actual ApplyConfChange.
MemoryStorage represents successful persistence under a no-crash assumption.
both_committed compares each public commit index against the independently preselected target index; entries_equal compares actual stored term/type/data. Raw operands are emitted.

plan_uncertainties: Applicability depends on the documented synchronous early-Advance permission covering delayed configuration application and continued processing by removed peers.
This bounded history does not establish all configuration schedules or an external client-visible application result.
